Whether you're planning a wedding, birthday, shower, corporate event, or special celebration, this is the perfect opportunity to explore the space and connect with trusted event professionals. We're beyond excited to unveil the first 14 of 28 incredible artists featured in Artist Ummah's ERA Exhibit at the Rumman Room This exhibition celebrates the beauty and reflection of the Ramadan & Eid season, and we are so grateful to the artists bringing this vision to life.
